import subprocess, os, socket

def run(cmd):
    try:
        return subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15).stdout.strip()
    except Exception as ex:
        return f"<error: {ex}>"

print("=== Processes (kv/replica/raft/etcd/consul/store/leader) ===")
ps = run("ps aux")
lines = [l for l in ps.splitlines() if any(k in l.lower() for k in
         ('kv', 'replicat', 'raft', 'etcd', 'consul', 'leader', 'follower', 'consensus', 'store'))]
print("\n".join(lines) if lines else "(no matching processes)")

print("\n=== Listening TCP sockets ===")
socks = run("ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null")
print(socks if socks else "(could not enumerate)")

print("\n=== Common service ports probe ===")
for port in (2379, 2380, 5000, 8000, 8080, 8500, 9000, 9090):
    s = socket.socket(); s.settimeout(0.3)
    open_ = s.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1', port)) == 0
    s.close()
    if open_:
        print(f"  port {port}: OPEN")
print("  (probe complete)")
```
